results.description:
Stitch. is a casual puzzle game with embroidery on a numbered grid. The main objective is to fill in the levels' areas with no gaps to complete Hoops. 
Stitch. lets you create beautiful embroidery patterns, by solving levels and Hoops of various difficulties and sizes. It's easy to learn, but hard to master! 
Stitch up all the beautiful landscapes, plants, animals, objects, and more.
 
SIMPLE RULES, CHALLENGING SOLUTIONS
Stitch. offers an expansive range of playable content and thousands of easy to extremely challenging levels. Pick the pattern, size, and category of the Hoop you prefer and move forward through the levels to create an embroidered masterpiece. 
 
REALISTIC EMBROIDERY ENGINE
Like any other form of art, hand embroidery brings you a peaceful, calming, and inspiring experience.
Developed in-house, the realistic embroidery engine helps you enjoy the feel of playing with the real embroidery thread on your device. 
 
REGULAR HOOPS
Stitch. features over 800 regular Hoops in multiple sizes and categories. 
Up to a long embroidery adventure? Pick a beautiful landscape hoop in XXL size. 
Looking for something quick and fun to help you unwind? - Stitch up a cute teddy bear or a colorful plant!
 Every Hoop you complete can then be shared.
 
WEEKLY HOOPS
Weekly Hoops are limited edition content that becomes available to play every week.
Discover a new Weekly Hoop every 7 days and get it solved until it is gone!
Weekly Hoops' themes and patterns reflect famous international events and unlock fun, educational facts about each of them.
 
Did you know World Embroidery Day is celebrated on July 30?
 
FREE STITCH MODE
After completion, each Hoop can be alternatively played in Free Stitch mode. Pick your favorite pattern and color it just the way you like!
Free Stitch mode becomes available after the tutorial steps completion.
 
CHALLENGES
Follow and complete all the various and fun challenges to collect points, upgrade in tiers and obtain achievements.
 
ACCESSIBILITY
Stitch. offers a range of accessibility features that are imported from your iOS/iPadOS settings and can be managed through the main menu of the game:
1. The “Number Outlines” feature creates sharper and more contrasted outlines for the numbers on the grid to help color blindness or the visually impaired.
2. The “Reduce Motion” feature disables all sudden movements and animations.
3. The “Big Numbers” feature increases the size of the numbers of the grid for better visibility. 
 
UNIVERSAL & FAMILY FRIENDLY
Stitch. is a family-friendly game, suitable for players of all ages and genders.
(IGRS rating: 3+)

results.description:
Small stitches. Something lovely.

Stitchwork is a cozy cross-stitch game you can play for two minutes or two hours. Pick a pattern, choose your thread and watch a picture appear one little X at a time. No tangled floss, no counting squares, no needle to lose in the sofa.

THREE WAYS TO STITCH

• Trace: no timer, no pressure. Pick a thread, then tap or sweep across its squares and fill in the pattern at your own pace. Leave whenever you like: your piece is saved and picks up right where you left off.

• Challenge: keep the needle fed. The needle sews the pattern by itself and asks for a colour, and you send it the matching spool. Stay a thread ahead for Seamless bonuses and a growing multiplier, but don't let the tension run out or the thread snaps. Earn up to three stars and beat your best time.

• Free Draw: a blank fabric and a basket of thread. Lay stitches wherever you like and design something that is entirely yours.

230+ PATTERNS TO COLLECT

• 14 collections: Cozy, Critters, Garden, Treats, Seaside, Sky, Landscapes, Cityscapes, Wonders, Holiday, Quilts, Mandalas, Samplers and Geometric.
• Every size, from tiny minis under 100 stitches to full 10,000-stitch showpieces you can get lost in for days.
• Big pieces are made for small screens: pinch to zoom, slide the fabric with two fingers, and let the target find that last hidden square of a colour.
• Every finished piece hangs in your Gallery with your stars and best times.

A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY DAY

• A fresh daily pattern for everyone, with a leaderboard to climb.
• Build a streak and earn bonus buttons.
• Optional gentle reminders so your streak never slips.

DRESS EVERY PIECE

• Choose the look of each piece before you start: thread, fabric and hoop, frame and needle.
• Thread finishes such as wool, ribbon, linen, neon, frosted, ember and aurora.
• 20 themed sets, including Christmas, Halloween, Valentine's Day, Summer, Diwali, Lunar New Year and Starry Night, each with its own needle, thread, hoop and frame.
• Earn buttons with every piece you finish and spend them in the Shop.

SHARE YOUR STITCHING

• Turn any finished piece into a share-ready picture card.
• Stitchwork Pro adds stitch-along videos that replay your piece stitch by stitch, plus extra card themes.
• Invite a friend: when they finish their first piece you get 1,000 buttons, two gift sets and bigger free patterns.

MADE TO UNWIND

• No sign-up needed. Start stitching right away, and sign in with Apple if you want your progress on all your devices.
• Designed for iPhone and iPad, with a roomy side-by-side layout in landscape on iPad.
• No banners, no pop-up ads. The only ads are optional: watch one when you choose to, to unlock an extra free piece.

STITCHWORK PRO

Stitchwork is free to start: try all three modes with a selection of small patterns. Stitchwork Pro is a single one-time purchase, not a subscription, and unlocks:

• Unlimited pieces in Challenge, Trace and Free Draw
• Every pattern in every size, up to 10,000 stitches
• Exclusive Pro threads, hoops, frames and needles
• Stitch-along videos and extra share card themes

Button packs are also available as optional in-app purchases if you'd rather not wait for your favourite set.

results.description:
Yarn Loop is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game featuring colorful yarn bobbins and knitted patterns.

Bobbins move onto the conveyor and collect stitches of their own color. Each bobbin has a capacity value that decreases as stitches are picked up. When its capacity reaches zero, the bobbin disappears. If capacity remains, the bobbin is transferred to the rack and can be used again later.
 
Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right order.

Game Features
► Simple One-Tap Gameplay: Bobbins move smoothly through the conveyor system and collect matching stitches with ease.
► Color-Based Collection Mechanic: Each bobbin clears only the stitches of its own color.
► Capacity Management System: Every bobbin has a limited pickup value, creating thoughtful and satisfying puzzle decisions.
► Rack Reuse Function: Bobbins that still have capacity return to the rack and remain available for later use.
► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
